headline: S&P Upgrades Uzbekistan's Credit Rating to Highest-Ever BB+
summary: S&P Global Ratings upgraded Uzbekistan's sovereign credit rating to BB+ from BB with a stable outlook. The new rating brings the country within one notch of investment-grade status following ongoing fiscal reforms.
why: Sovereign credit ratings determine borrowing costs for national governments and influence international institutional capital flows into emerging markets.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: S&P rating upgrade to BB+ improves creditworthiness and lowers international sovereign borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: S&P's upgrade to BB+ validated economic reforms and strengthened investor confidence in Uzbekistan's debt profile.
